narrativeProgression.description: Mufti introduces the question of intimacy with a pregnant wife and promises a detailed explanation.
He states that it is permissible in Islam, emphasizing that there is no prohibition or objection.
Mufti elaborates on the importance of consulting a doctor and if the doctor advises against it, then it becomes impermissible.
He reiterates that if the doctor does not object, intimacy remains permissible.
He concludes by advising the audience to seek proper understanding and prays for guidance from Allah.
